caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet composed of two distinct sections. The upper portion is structured and rounded, rendered in a light tan color with a woven texture pattern, resembling straw or a similar material. The lower section consists of a gathered, soft-looking cloth in a light blue and white checkered or grid pattern, extending downward and fanning out. Attached to the sides of this cloth portion are long, narrow ribbons of the same blue and white patterned material, with one ribbon shown loosely curved and draping downward. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Shaker Bonnet
